A lathed part is milled on a Vertical Milling Machine for 46 minutes using an end mill with carbide tip at a milling speed of 1200 rpm and a depth of cut of 2 mm, resulting in a milled part that is then stored in the MobileRobot.

A turning operation is performed on a CNC Turning Center for 95 minutes using a standard gear shaft profile cnc program, with tools calibrated to a 0.005 mm tolerance and the spindle speed set at 1800 rpm, starting with a lathed part held by a mobile robot and ending with a finished milled part conveyed to the conveyor belt.

A broaching operation is performed on a Broaching Machine for 4 minutes using a tapered broach for internal thread at a feed rate of 0.5 mm/rev and a depth of cut of 10 mm, transforming a Metal bar from the ConveyorBelt into a Broached component that is transferred to a MobileRobot.

The shaping operation is performed on a Shaper for 55 minutes using a Carbide tool with positive rake, with a shaping speed of 3 mm/min and a stroke length of 150 mm, starting with a Milled part on a MobileRobot and producing a Shaped part that is transferred to a ConveyorBelt.

The planing operation is performed on a Planer for 80 minutes to reduce the surface of a Milled part to produce a Planed part, with a cut depth of 3 mm, a feed rate of 0.8 mm/rev, and a surface finish of Ra 1.6 μm, after which the Planed part is transferred to the ConveyorBelt.

A drilling operation is performed on a Metal bar using a Drill Press for 79 minutes at a spindle speed of 1400 rpm, a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev, and a drill size of 6 mm, resulting in a DrilledComponent that is transferred to a MobileRobot.

A precision cutting operation is performed on a Wire EDM (Electrical Discharge Machine) for 35 minutes using a molybdenum wire with a pulse duration of 50 ns, peak current of 15A, and a cutting speed of 0.1 mm/s, transforming a shaped part on a conveyor belt into a precision finished ground part that is transferred to a mobile robot.
A Bandsaw performs sawing on a Metal bar for 11 minutes at 1000 rpm using a Tungsten carbide blade with a cutting width of 20 mm, producing a Lathed part that is transferred to a MobileRobot.

A spur gear with 24 teeth is shaped on a Gear Shaper for 4 minutes at a shaping speed of 1.2 mm/rev, starting from a broached component held by a mobile robot and ending as a shaped gear conveyed to the conveyor belt.

Gear hobbing is performed on a Hobbing Machine for 24 minutes at a hobbing speed of 800 rpm and a feed rate of 0.3 mm/rev using a standard involute profile, transforming a broached component held by a MobileRobot into a hobbied gear that is then transferred to a ConveyorBelt.

A precision milling operation is performed on a Stewart Platform Mill for 63 minutes using a 5-axis tool array with a milling precision of ±0.002 mm and an active vibration damping system, transforming a milled part carried by a mobile robot into a ground part that is then conveyed to a conveyor belt.

A grinding operation is performed on a Grinding Machines using an Al oxide wheel at 3000 rpm with a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev, transforming a Planed part from the ConveyorBelt into a Ground part that is transferred to a MobileRobot, for 14 minutes.

Turning is performed on a Vertical Lathe for 34 minutes using a Carbide turning tool at a rotation speed of 600 rpm and a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev, starting with a Metal bar on a ConveyorBelt and producing a Lathed part that is transferred to a MobileRobot.
On the Screw Machines, a lathed part is screwed with an M6 coarse thread screw for 14 minutes to produce a screwed component, which is then transferred to the conveyor belt.

A horizontal milling operation is performed on a Horizontal Milling Machine for 57 minutes using a milling speed of 1000 rpm, following a contour profile with 3-axis interpolation to achieve a surface finish of Ra 3.2 µm, starting with a milled part held by a mobile robot and ending with a finished machined component transferred to a conveyor belt.

Turning is performed on a Horizontal Lathe for 58 minutes using a High-speed steel tool at a rotation speed of 500 rpm and a feed rate of 0.3 mm/rev, starting with a Metal bar on a ConveyorBelt and producing a Lathed part that is transferred to a MobileRobot.

The honing operation is performed on a Honing Machine for 14 minutes using a 60 grit honing tool to finish a honed cylinder with a bore size of 50 mm, starting from the MobileRobot and resulting in a precision finished part that is transferred to the ConveyorBelt.

Punching is performed on a Punch Press for 60 minutes using a 10 mm punch size, a stroke speed of 1.5 m/s, and die alignment within ±0.05 mm, starting with sheet metal on a ConveyorBelt and producing a finished sheet metal product on the same ConveyorBelt.
